description: He wears a long deep burgundy plum outer coat with narrow gold patterned edging on the front, collar, sleeves and hem. Two circular gold clasps sit high on the chest. A cream textured undertunic shows down the central opening and a decorated brown belt with a round buckle and hanging strap gathers the waist. Dark trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots. His head is bare, with no headgear, armor or weapon. Both arms rest behind his back, naturally hiding his hands, and both boots remain visible.
